events.title: Demo Update v1.0.3
events.summary: Demo v1.0.3 is now live. Here's what changed. New Feature - Added categories. You can now pick one before setting sail to label your focus time. - The diary can now break down your focus time by category. Added - A Records tab in the diary, showing the details of every voyage. Changed - The diary day now starts at 4:00 AM, and every voyage is recorded on the day it set sail. - Voyages with under 1 minute of focus no longer appear in the diary's records or charts. - Voyages finished before this u

events.title: Demo Update v1.0.2
events.summary: Demo v1.0.2 is out, bringing the new Ambience Mixer! New Feature- Added the Ambience Mixer: play up to four tracks at once, each with its own volume. Added- Five built-in ambience tracks. - A visual effect when the submarine salvages an item. - New Captain's Log events. ChangedAlong with the mixer update: - "White noise" is renamed "Ambience". - The custom audio folder White Noise is renamed Ambience (files in the old folder still work).

events.title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage - Demo Out Now!
events.summary: The demo for Dive Log: A Focus Voyage is out now. Your submarine dives while you focus, and comes back from every session with a hold full of treasure. In the demo・All timing modes are available: Focus Sessions, Deep Focus, Stopwatch and Custom Time. ・The first sea zone, Coastal, is fully open. ・Submarine parts can be upgraded to level 2. ・Music and white noise are included, and you can load in your own audio files. ・Mini Mode: shrink the window into a corner of your desktop and keep the timer,
